repair_root_cause: Hosted public Step 7 repeatedly entered a recursion loop: V17 temporarily monkeypatched the shared V1 defense module to bridged_defense, while V2/V3 could resolve their base alias to that same mutable module object. The intended V3 -> V2 -> V1 call graph then became V17 bridged_defense -> V3 -> V2 -> V17 bridged_defense.
repair_patch: V76 now creates a per-render isolated namespace containing the frozen certified V1 defense entry points, temporarily points V2/V3 base aliases at that namespace, restores both aliases after render, and uses a builtins-owned process RLock so module purge/re-import cannot create competing Step 7 render locks. Frozen Steps 1-6 files remain untouched; provider functions and math are unchanged.
